TOOLING BURST T4s-r2 — the G2 FIELDS do not show in the scene (Run C-5, E3; conductor in-scene evidence R-C5-60). task_id "T4s-r2". Diagnose first, then the smallest fix.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4s (your contract), T4r (decal precedent).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (the G2 component + its emission: `g2_thrown_field.tscn`/script; the ground layer parenting and z/sort of the FIELD body, the density puff, the decal; T4r's decal placement as the working precedent), export/effect_kit.py (G2 kit fields), export/props_layer.py + export/parallax_scene.py (how the scene's ground/foreground/actors layers and y-sort are emitted — the field must sit ABOVE the painted foreground canvas and BELOW actors, sorted by its ground point), the conductor's in-scene captures: runs/C-5/t3/E1-judge-v28/BWC_dirt_E_contact.png and PC_dirt_E_contact.png (frames labelled in real frame numbers), tests/test_godot_import.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

EVIDENCE (real scene, cliffside_v28, cast east from (3760,640), touch-device aim, 1:1 camera): Blackwater — the flask is never visible in flight (frames 8–26 show nothing between the caster and the landing point), the splash burst appears at ~f64, then only a small lick pulses at f84–108 — NO burning pool body and NO scorch decal are visible. Concoction — nothing visible at all except a small green blob at ~f52 (the flask landing?) — no lobe splash, no density cloud, no puddle. Your headless traces report the field alive, ticks, tints and decal timing — so the nodes exist and run; they are not SEEN. Hypotheses to test in order: (a) the field/decal/cloud nodes are parented under the ground layer BELOW the painted foreground canvas (z or tree order) and are painted over; (b) the flask sprite is drawn at a scale/alpha that vanishes (the RGB flask is 46×70 px — it should be visible for 0.55 s); (c) the density cloud's alpha/coverage starts at 0 and never reaches the runtime (density field applied twice, or the MIX material with index RGB draws grey at zero alpha); (d) the field's ground_squash or position puts it off the landing point. Prove each with a headless trace that records each node's global z / layer / parent path / modulate alpha / visible / global position at three ages, then FIX the one(s) that are wrong: field body, cloud, licks and decal on the scene's ground-effects layer (above the foreground canvas, below actors, y-sorted at the landing point); flask visible for its flight; density reaching the shader.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r2/acceptance.json): per node the trace table before/after; previously registered kits byte-identical except the two G2 kits' emitted scene; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite reds named. Rendered proof is the conductor's (the next in-scene capture must show the pool, the cloud and the decals).

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the one named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r2/ and the two G2 kit.json files if a kit field must change. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4s-r2/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4s-r2"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
